answer_text: NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN typically indicates a transform mismatch between the two VPN peers (IKE/P1 or ESP/P2). Check the AWS VGW configuration against the Cato IPsec site settings to ensure the IKE and ESP transforms (and related options) match. Review the tunnel timeline for the exact mismatch shown (the timeline can highlight the specific p1/p2 problem), and align AWS settings with Cato’s recommended default IPsec settings for AWS.
